home.headline: Here are the answers.

items.question: Can I connect my Google calendar?
items.answer: Yes. You can connect Google Calendar from settings screen under connect tab.

items.question: How accurate is the AI summary?
items.answer: We use the latest LLM technologies specifically. It analyze nuance and technical details with over 98% user satisfaction.

items.question: Does AppDrop work offline?
items.answer: Yes. Your data is stored locally and syncs to the cloud as soon as you're back online.

items.question: What are free plan limitations?
items.answer: Free plan gives generous limits. If you need Advanced AI Analysis Consider subscribing to Pro plan.

items.question: Can I use AppDrop with my team?
items.answer: Absolutely. Shared Workspaces in the Pro plan allow for team collaboration.
